entities.name: Varragoth, Bloodsky Sire
entities.description: A demon rogue from Kaldheim who escaped Immersturm and led the Skelle; killed by a planeswalker.

entities.name: Skelle
entities.description: Bretagard clan raiders who allied with Varragoth.

entities.name: Gods of Kaldheim
entities.description: Gods who battled Varragoth and returned him to Immersturm.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker attacked by Varragoth who carried the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: Sword Varragoth sought to take to prevent the closure of the Omenpaths.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Elf who held back demons and made the axes.

entities.name: Arni
entities.description: Companion of Kaya swept from the raven.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: God to whom Kaya delivered the Sword.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: Army that fought alongside the demons.

events.summary: Varragoth escapes Immersturm and becomes leader of the Skelle raiders, leading them in a massacre to Beskir Hall.
events.quote: He led them to Beskir Hall , slaughtering anyone they found along the way.

events.summary: The gods battle Varragoth for a month and wrestle him back to Immersturm.
events.quote: battled Varragoth for an entire month before finally wrestling him back to Immersturm

events.summary: During the Doomskar, Varragoth leaves Immersturm with an army of demons to attack the realms.
events.quote: Varragoth managed to leave Immersturm with an army of demons

events.summary: Varragoth attacks Kaya to take the Sword of the Realms and sweeps Kaya, Tyvar and Arni off their raven.
events.quote: He swept Kaya, Tyvar Kell and Arni from the giant raven

events.summary: Cosima stops Varragoth as he attacks Kaya.
Elves led by Harald arrive and Tyvar holds off the demons and Karfell's army so Kaya can reach Halvar.
events.quote: Tyvar and the elves tried to hold the demons and Karfell 's army to give Kaya time to reach Halvar.

events.summary: After Kaya delivers the Sword to Halvar, Varragoth attacks again and is killed when a planeswalker slits his throat with one of Tyvar's axes.
events.quote: was killed by the planeswalker who slit the demon's throat using one of the axes made by Tyvar

relations.quote: he quickly established himself as the leader of the Skelle raiders

relations.note: nursed a grudge for a century
relations.quote: nursed a grudge against the gods and Bretagard for a century
was killed by the planeswalker who slit the demon's throat
